introduction: Utah weatherization applications go to the agency serving your county. The program focuses on home energy efficiency.
description: Utah weatherization applications go to the agency serving your county. The program focuses on home energy efficiency.

sections.who: The local provider reviews household eligibility and the dwelling under current program requirements.
sections.get: Approved energy-saving work intended to reduce costs and improve comfort and safety.
sections.docs:
• Income information requested locally.
  • Dwelling and occupancy records.
  • Requested rental or ownership information.
sections.apply:
1. Locate county intake

    Use the state provider directory.

  2. Request the checklist

    Confirm current openings and required verification.

  3. Arrange assessment

    Discuss the home and approved work with the provider.
sections.after: Ask about waiting lists and do not arrange reimbursable work without program authorization.
sections.sources: Checked October 1, 2026 using Current weatherization county intake, Program purpose. USA Assistance background guide. Program staff determine eligibility and available assistance.

faqs: Is there a county-based application route?
Yes. The state directs applications to the agency serving the resident’s county.
Its stated purpose is energy efficiency.
Should I use the old housing URL?
The current directory is under the state community/scso route.

provenance.scope: Published eligibility, service purpose and application pathway; no unverified financial limits or deadlines included.
